checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan: Add one-click quick start actions to launcher and root entrypoint

impact_assessment.why: Enable zero-friction onboarding and instant one-click entrainment session start conforming to PRINCIPLE-011 and photic bio-safety invariants
impact_assessment.benefits: Instant safe entrainment (40Hz Gamma, 10Hz Alpha) in 1 click from GUI or script; zero configuration hurdles for human users and subagents
impact_assessment.risks: contract: adds quick_start methods and root start script; dependency: pure stdlib / existing requirements; concurrency: subprocess supervision unchanged; state: launcher UI frame and entries updated
impact_assessment.mitigation: Enforce SAFE photic risk tier on quick start presets; retain 300-line budget in launcher.py; test thoroughly in headless test suite; 5/5 gates

checkpoints.description: [1/4] Unify frequency validation in core.safety; engine delegates

impact_assessment.why: SessionController.validate discards the degraded waveform from core.safety's duplicate Nyquist check; risk assessment (SQUARE=0.95 PSE) diverges from what the engine runs (degraded to SINE), and two validation copies can drift
impact_assessment.benefits: Single source of truth for Nyquist/duty-cycle rules; controller applies the degraded waveform so the photic assessment matches executed stimulus; sham-seed reproducible end to end
impact_assessment.risks: contract: engine public validate_frequency signature kept; dependency: core must not import engine (cycle); concurrency: none - pure functions; state: frozen protocol replaced via dataclasses.replace
impact_assessment.mitigation: Engine delegates to core.safety.validate_hardware_limits keeping signature and return; controller uses returned tuple; failing-first tests for degradation application and sham_seed CLI roundtrip; full check gate plus unittest before each commit
